detailed_descriptions.en: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem is a short tower defense game with incremental-style meta-progression. A bazillion orcs Defend your base against an overwhelming number of orcs. They're coming with tens of thousands of troops to overrun you. Greet them with even more bullets, bombs and lasers! Massive upgrade tree Use resources earned from every run, won or lost, to unlock and upgrade powerful turrets. Every upgrade brings you closer to defeating the horde. Active abilities Launch strafing runs, orbital lasers and even nukes to slaughter masses of orcs and survive critical situations.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Sir, We Have an Orc Problem is a short tower defense game with incremental-style meta-progression.

A bazillion orcs

Defend your base against an overwhelming number of orcs. They're coming with tens of thousands of troops to overrun you. Greet them with even more bullets, bombs and lasers!

Massive upgrade tree

Use resources earned from every run, won or lost, to unlock and upgrade powerful turrets. Every upgrade brings you closer to defeating the horde.

Active abilities

Launch strafing runs, orbital lasers and even nukes to slaughter masses of orcs and survive critical situations.
